speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: asked	the Minister for Communications and Information (a) what is the number of applicants applying for the digital TV assistance scheme in the last two years; and (b) whether the Ministry is fully satisfied that residents are aware of the move from analogue to digital TV and the shutdown of analogue TV channels in 2017.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: MDA produces DTV information booklets in four languages that are sent to individual homes once the estate is DTV-ready.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: MDA has also advertised the digital switchover initiative on TV, radio, Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) trains, bus stop shelters, as well as print and online media.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: MDA is partnering retailers and organising roadshows in the heartlands to encourage early DTV adoption.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: There are several reasons why a household may choose not to accept the assistance package.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: The third possibility may be that despite the letters going out, they may still be unaware of the transition to digital broadcasting.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: It is this third possibility that we are most concerned about.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: We will continue to engage the public and our stakeholders to raise DTV awareness.

speaker: Mdm Speaker
text: You did not put up your hand, but okay.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: I think the DTV roll-out will give an indication of the issues we have to look out for when we embark on the Smart Nation initiative.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: There are telephone numbers on the booklets which they can call to seek help.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: There is a website which they can turn to.
